description: This file defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes for handling firmware tags, encryption, checksums, and file operations related to Buffalo devices.

methods.name: enc_compute_header_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of the firmware header based on product and version strings.

methods.name: enc_compute_buf_len
methods.description: Calculates the buffer length needed for firmware data based on product, version, and data length.

methods.name: encrypt_buf
methods.description: Encrypts data using specified encryption parameters.

methods.name: decrypt_buf
methods.description: Decrypts data using specified encryption parameters.

methods.name: bcrypt_init
methods.description: Initializes the bcrypt context with a key and specified state length.

methods.name: bcrypt_process
methods.description: Processes data with bcrypt context, transforming source to destination.

methods.name: bcrypt_finish
methods.description: Finalizes bcrypt processing, cleaning up context.

methods.name: bcrypt_buf
methods.description: Performs bcrypt-based transformation on data with a seed and key.

methods.name: buffalo_csum
methods.description: Computes a checksum over a buffer.

methods.name: buffalo_crc
methods.description: Computes a CRC over a buffer.

methods.name: get_file_size
methods.description: Returns the size of a specified file.

methods.name: read_file_to_buf
methods.description: Reads file contents into a buffer.

methods.name: write_buf_to_file
methods.description: Writes buffer contents to a file.
